value.rationale: Counting invertible finite-field matrices by successful ordered leading principal determinant tests is a natural sharp refinement of ordinary GL_n counting and characterizes the amount of pivotless elimination possible in a uniform invertible matrix. The exact full histogram and Gaussian variance 2 c_q A_q - c_q(1-c_q) quantify joint dependence and fluctuations, information not furnished by known marginal corank distributions or the ergodic mean. The result does not assert new Markov-chain renewal theory.
